blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A man listed as Oriental Mindoro’s most wanted person was arrested, while a former communist rebel surrendered in Occidental Mindoro on Friday, Oct. 16, police said. In a report on Saturday, the Police Regional Office Mimaropa said the 48-year-old wanted man was nabbed at 6:10 p.m. in Barangay Pag-asa, Bansud, Oriental Mindoro. He was facing warrants for alleged violations of Republic Act No. 9516, which regulates explosives and incendiary devices, with no bail recommended, and attempted homicide, with bail set at P36,000. He was taken to the Roxas Municipal Police Station for documentation and proper disposition. […]... Keep on reading: Most wanted man in Oriental Mindoro falls; ex-rebel turns himself in
